cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: I Can Handle This
cards.instruction: Perform complete emotional readiness while quietly borrowing coping strategies from every response around you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Remember my rule: prepare before you panic. I'm completely ready for this rejection email. Why have you brought water?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Small sips helped when I lost my job.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you haven't forgotten everything. Leave the jug; small sips are exactly how I prepare.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I had my sister read the email aloud. Want me to?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. I always arrange a reader. Start gently; that's part of my system.

reason: Preserve the original appropriation mechanism and recorded passing assessment while removing nearly/exactly repetition and giving the claimed prior instruction a natural specific form.
